description: Fonte oficial das apps do João Afonso. As versões vêm dos GitHub Releases e são atualizadas automaticamente a cada lançamento.

apps.name: Duotone
apps.subtitle: YouTube e Spotify numa só biblioteca
apps.localizedDescription: Make music yours. Tune each track, take control across iPhone and Windows, discover new favourites and build playlists with friends.

versions.localizedDescription:
Poster: a photo of the artist fills Now Playing, a different one for each song.
Black and white with grain, or in colour, fading into the photo's own colour at the top and bottom.
Pick it in Customise, or the new Poster theme does it all in one tap.
Controls, in Customise: keep the heart and the play ring white, with the colour only in the background.

Duotone for iPhone 6.1.1

New
- Poster, in Customise → Artwork: a photo of the artist behind the top, the title and the controls. Each song gets its own photo while the artist has photos; without them, the artwork. The lyrics still turn in the square.
- Poster image: artist photos or the artwork. Black and white: the Poster with grain, like a printed photo.
- The Poster theme: artist photos in black and white, "Playing from", the ring play button and white controls in one tap.
- Controls, in Customise → Now Playing: Accent colour or White for the heart, the play ring, the dots, shuffle and repeat.

Improved
- The preview in Customise shows the progress bar in white, as in Now Playing.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.1.0...ios-v6.1.1

Playlist folders: keep your playlists together, and move, rename or undo a folder whenever you like.
The queue: shuffle what's next again, or select several songs to play next or remove, with Undo.
Radio never gives you the same queue twice for the same song.
Your drawer works like the Home Screen: hold a tile to lift it, drag it anywhere, and pull its corner to resize it.

Duotone for iPhone 6.1.0

New
- Playlist folders, in Playlists.
- Shuffle again and select several songs in the queue.
- Share an album with a friend from the album's menu.
- Export your library in Settings: Liked Songs, playlists and albums, as JSON or CSV.
- ListenBrainz scrobbling in Settings: paste your token and your listens go straight from your phone. Private listening sends nothing.

Improved
- The drawer: drag tiles to move them, pull the corner to resize, tap an empty spot to finish. Only your spaces sit on top, friends who aren't playing open their profile, and the now-playing cover has no black bars.
- In edit mode, the space name shows in your language.
- An artist's songs are in one list, in the order you choose.
- Liked Songs and playlists scroll faster, and the app keeps its data in faster storage.
- The keyboard in conversations moves smoothly with the text.
- Closing the player no longer zooms out the app behind it.

Fixed
- The menus in the queue and Radio now open next to the button, not at the top of the screen.
- The Home keeps its rounded corners when the drawer is open.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.0.5...ios-v6.1.0

The drawer opens with a swipe anywhere on Home, not just from the edge.
It takes on the colours of what's playing, and no longer flickers when it opens.
Hold any tile to edit your drawer. The Edit button is gone.
New drawers start with the Night scene, and yours gets it once if it has no scene yet.

Duotone for iPhone 6.0.5

Improved
- Swipe right anywhere on Home to open your drawer. Swiping left still takes you to Songs, and the shelves keep their own scrolling.
- The drawer's background follows the colours of the song that's playing, and the tiles let them through.
- Holding a tile is now the way to edit; Done appears while you edit. An empty space shows Add.
- The drawer starts with the Night scene.

Fixed
- The tiles no longer blink when the drawer opens: they appear in order as it slides in.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.0.4...ios-v6.0.5

Your own drawer on Home: swipe from the left edge, or tap the new button next to Home.
Fill it with artists, playlists, friends, controls and shortcuts. Hold any tile to edit your drawer.
Scenes change several settings in one tap, like Night: private listening and a 30 min sleep timer. Tap it again and everything goes back.
It starts with what you play most, so it's ready the first time you open it.

Duotone for iPhone 6.0.4

New
- The drawer on Home: spaces (Everyday and up to four more), and tiles for what's playing, your PC, artists, playlists, albums, friends, the sleep timer, private listening, speed, shuffle, radio and the places you go to most.
- Scenes: Night, Focus, Gym and Drive are ready to add, and the scene editor makes your own.

Improved
- The update notice shows what's new, instead of the version title.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.0.3...ios-v6.0.4

Duotone for iPhone 6.0.3

Improved
- Skipping is smooth: the cover's move to the next song now runs in iOS itself, so changing song can't make it stutter.
- The cover no longer dims for a moment on every skip. It only pulses when a song takes a while to load.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.0.2...ios-v6.0.3

Duotone for iPhone 6.0.2

New
- Duotone in French: Settings › Appearance › Language. English stays the default, and the new language shows the next time you open Duotone.
- Download Liked Songs in Settings › Storage: all of them, and the ones you like later. On mobile data it waits for Wi-Fi.
- Start Radio in a song's menu: it plays the song and fills Up next with music like it.
- Show what your PC is playing, in Settings › General: turn it off and your PC's music stops showing up here.
- More buttons for below the player, in Settings › Customise › Buttons below: Sleep timer, Start Radio, Add to playlist, Download and Car mode. The sleep timer shows the time left.

Improved
- The buttons below the player fit their names on one line.
- The equaliser is now separate on iPhone and PC: each song's EQ and speed, and your default EQ, stay on the platform where you set them. Your presets are still the same on both.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v6.0.1...ios-v6.0.2

Duotone for iPhone 6.0.1

New
- Save albums to your library. They live in an Albums folder at the top of Playlists: tap ♡ on an album, or hold it and choose Save album.
- Download a whole playlist at once from its ⋯ menu. On mobile data it waits for Wi-Fi, unless you tap Use mobile data.
- Report a problem in Settings: tell the developer what happened, with the playback report if you want.

Improved
- If sign-ups are closed for a while, Duotone says so clearly.

Fixed
- Some imported songs played the music video instead of the song, which put the lyrics out of time.

Minimum version: 6.0.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.9.4...ios-v6.0.1

Duotone for iPhone 5.9.4

Fixed
- Messages, friends' status and what they're playing keep arriving live when Duotone has been open for a long time. If the server drops the live connection, Duotone reconnects by itself.

Minimum version: 5.9.4

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.9.3...ios-v5.9.4

Duotone for iPhone 5.9.3

New
- Choose how much space saved songs can use, from 10 MB to unlimited, in Settings › Storage.
- Download the IPA straight from the update notice, then open it in SideStore or AltStore.

Fixed
- On your profile, your name in the top bar no longer runs into the buttons when you scroll.

Improved
- Much lighter on the server: what you listen to is sent in one small batch every few minutes, and friends' online status no longer writes to the database. This keeps Duotone free for everyone.
- Friends' status and what they're playing arrive live.
- The like button in the player answers instantly.

Minimum version: 5.9.3

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.9.2...ios-v5.9.3

Duotone for iPhone 5.9.2

Fixed
- Tapping the player on the lock screen or in the Dynamic Island opens Duotone.

Minimum version: 5.9.1

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v5.9.1...ios-v5.9.2
